note: Van Wert County publishes zoning only as PDF township zoning codes and a zoning officials map image (2021). County GIS downloads list parcels, address points, centerlines and municipalities, no zoning. The only GIS is the auditor's web map viewer with no discoverable public zoning service. City of Van Wert zoning is in the municipal code text, not a queryable layer. ArcGIS searches found only a 1980 zoning Hub document, not a service.
